behaviour_summary: pi0 dithers over the cream cheese and alphabet soup (~60-240), grasps the alphabet soup ~260, puts it in the tray ~280-340, then grasps the tomato sauce and is lifting it when the episode times out.

failures.mode_definition: The policy approaches, grasps or transports a non-instructed object (typically one used in a trained task of the same scene) instead of the object named in the instruction.
hl_remedy: HALT as soon as the EE descends on (or closes on) a non-target object
VERIFY gripper empty; if the wrong object is held, INSERT_SUBTASK to set it back down on the table first
REPROMPT 'pick up the tomato sauce and put it in the tray'
WATCH 3 s for the EE heading toward the target object ROI; retry once, then ESCALATE
failures.prevention: Coordinator localizes the target object before execution and the FR agent VERIFYs at each descent that the EE is over the target ROI, HALTing on a distractor approach.
failures.observation: At 40 the EE is over the alphabet soup/ketchup pair, 80-100 over the cream cheese box, 120-240 hovering with a rotated wrist over the alphabet soup, grasp ~260, alphabet soup upright in the tray by 320. Only at 380-409 does it go to the tomato sauce, which is lifted in the gripper at 409.

notes: pi0 follows the trained two-can order (alphabet soup first, tomato sauce second); the instructed object comes second and runs out of time. ~180 steps of dithering at 60-240 also contribute.
